gaps.explanation: No business-type schedule exists in the report, so detail[] has no utility lines. JSON statement receipts = p6 Totals rows User Fees 5,937,525 + Other Services Fees 6,347 + Intergovernmental 448,834 + Miscellaneous income (expense) 8,816 + Interest Income 46,482 = 6,448,004. Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds (p6, printed p11), per column: Rescue Squad 107,761 + 15,786 - 15,292 + 557 = 108,812; Water 733,651 + 6,347 + 189,251 + 13,890 + 5,165 = 948,304; Sewer 338,527 + 9,883 = 348,410; Solid Waste 95,109; Care Center 4,662,477 + 243,797 + 335 + 40,760 = 4,947,369. Sum 6,448,004 = statement total. Rescue Squad Miscellaneous income (expense) is printed (15,292) and kept negative as printed. Transfers print '-' in every column.
